description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources used in the AttrEval-Simulation, as referenced in the paper “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models.” It is divided into six distinct segments, each representing a different dataset: ENTITYQUEST (26.0%, blue), HOTPOTQA (24.2%, red), TRIVIAQA (22.7%, orange), POPQA (21.6%, yellow), WEBQUESTIO (3.6%, teal), and a small unlabeled gray segment (1.9%). The segments are arranged clockwise from the top-right, with ENTITYQUEST occupying the largest portion and the gray segment the smallest. Each slice is labeled with its corresponding dataset name and percentage, connected via thin lines to avoid overlap. The chart visually emphasizes the relative dominance of ENTITYQUEST and HOTPOTQA, which together account for over half of the data sources, while WEBQUESTIO and the unlabeled gray category constitute minor contributions. No legend is present, as labels are directly annotated on the chart. The overall design is clean and functional, facilitating quick comparison of dataset proportions in the simulation framework.
